verses.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਵਡਾ ਆਖੀਐ ਵਡੇ ਦੀ ਵਡੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ।
verses.translit_en: satigur vaddaa aakheeaai vadde dhee vaddee vaddiaaiee|

en.bdb: The true Guru is called great and the glory of the great is also great.

verses.gurmukhi: ਓਅੰਕਾਰਿ ਅਕਾਰੁ ਕਰਿ ਲਖ ਦਰੀਆਉ ਨ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਪਾਈ।
verses.translit_en: oa(n)kaar akaar kar lakh dhareeaau na keemat paiee|

en.bdb: Oankar has assumed the form of the world and millions of life-streams could not know about His grandeur.

verses.gurmukhi: ਇਕ ਵਰਭੰਡੁ ਅਖੰਡੁ ਹੈ ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਕਰਿ ਰਿਜਕੁ ਦਿਵਾਈ।
verses.translit_en: eik varabha(n)dd akha(n)dd hai jeea ja(n)t kar rijak dhivaiee|

en.bdb: The One Lord uninterruptedly is pervading the whole universe and provides livelihood to all creatures.

verses.gurmukhi: ਲੂੰਅ ਲੂੰਅ ਵਿਚਿ ਰਖਿਓਨੁ ਕਰਿ ਵਰਭੰਡ ਕਰੋੜਿ ਸਮਾਈ।
verses.translit_en: loo(n)a loo(n)a vich rakhion kar varabha(n)dd karoR samaiee|

en.bdb: That Lord has subsumed crores of universes in His each trichome.

verses.gurmukhi: ਕੇਵਡੁ ਵਡਾ ਆਖੀਐ ਕਵਣ ਥਾਉ ਕਿਸੁ ਪੁਛਾ ਜਾਈ।
verses.translit_en: kevadd vaddaa aakheeaai kavan thaau kis puchhaa jaiee|

en.bdb: How His expanse may be explained and whom should one ask as to where He resides.

verses.gurmukhi: ਅਪੜਿ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਹੰਘਈ ਸੁਣਿ ਸੁਣਿ ਆਖਣ ਆਖਿ ਸੁਣਾਈ।
verses.translit_en: apaR koi na ha(n)ghiee sun sun aakhan aakh sunaiee|

en.bdb: None can reach Him; all talk about Him is on the basis of hearsay.
That Lord has become manifest in the form of the true Guru.
